results.conditions: 24 items onboard at second five, five seconds to travel, three to settle and 0.5 seconds per delivery.

results.claim: Congestion delayed two robots by 13.05 seconds apiece
results.conditions: Six occupied robot volumes in the kickoff AUTO rehearsal.
results.limit: A simulated AUTO conflict. Shift waits depend on other robots and the chosen route.

results.claim: Two of nine conditions cleared the HUB opening
results.conditions: One 215 g FUEL from carpet pickup and guided lift to the registered opening.
results.limit: Seven conditions stayed below the opening. The downstream trace reaches the bottom plate. Optical scoring and repeated service remain open.

results.claim: One active-HUB point at 16.987 s in Shift 1
results.conditions: One 215 g FUEL; +250 mm clear scoring approach; 1 m/s prescribed field roller and wheels; 30,000 N/m candidate contact input.
results.limit: The same passage earns zero in an inactive HUB. A stationary field counter retains the ball. Repeated service remains open.
